hooks.name: Block inline credentials in shell commands
hooks.description: Refuses tool calls carrying a credential inline (rzp_live_, sk-, AIza, ghp_, AKIA, PEM private keys, or SECRET/TOKEN=<long literal>). Prevents the mechanism that leaked four live keys into Kiro's workspace permissions file on 2026-09-19, where "Always allow" recorded the whole command string verbatim. Also matches mcp_aws_mcp_aws___run_script, whose Python `code` payload could carry a literal credential just as a shell command can; the guard script is already schema-agnostic and needed no change to scan it.

action.command: D=/Users/wecaredigital/wecare-digital/wecare-digital; if [ -x "$D/.venv/bin/python" ]; then exec "$D/.venv/bin/python" "$D/scripts/block_inline_secrets.py"; else exec /usr/bin/python3 "$D/scripts/block_inline_secrets.py"; fi
